csv_project_name: AE for Southeast Region Multi Disciplinary
csv_agency: National Park Service - Department of Interior
csv_location: Jefferson (LA), Autauga (AL), Alachua (FL), Appling (GA), Adair (KY), Adams (MS), Alamance (NC), Abbeville (SC), Anderson (TN)
csv_scope_of_work: The National Park Service (NPS), Denver Service Center (DSC), 1 Denver Federal Center, Building 50 Denver CO 80225 United States, is requesting professional qualifications (SF-330s) from qualified firms to provide general engineering and supporting services under an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract for a variety of projects within Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, Kentucky, South Carolina, North Carolina, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 140P2026R0055- Contract Value: $100.0M- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 05/06/2026 12:00 PM MDT - This is a Special Notice- Multiple contracts may be awarded
title: AE for Southeast Region Multi Disciplinary
short_description: IDIQ for multidisciplinary engineering services for National Park Service projects across the Southeast region.
project_location: Multiple locations in Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, Kentucky, South Carolina, North Carolina, Puerto Rico, and the Virgin Islands.
project_scope: Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity contract for a variety of National Park Service projects in the Southeast Region. The notice requests professional qualifications from qualified firms to provide general engineering and supporting services. No specific building, bridge, span, floor area, or individual project technical characteristics are defined in the notice.
services: General engineering and supporting services under an IDIQ contract; multidisciplinary AE services; qualifications-based submission via SF-330.
relevance_explanation:
- Very broad multidisciplinary IDIQ without defined technical scope.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building identified.
- Framework-style contract with multiple future task orders, which is generally less relevant without technical specification.
- Could include building-related work, but current notice is too unspecific for targeted structural engineering positioning.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender notice as contract value for the IDIQ; this appears to be total contract capacity, not construction cost of a specific project.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. The notice only gives an overall IDIQ contract value of 100,000,000 USD and does not define the share attributable to structural engineering or sbp-relevant services.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms must submit professional qualifications using SF-330 for multidisciplinary AE/general engineering services. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific structural qualifications are stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: National Park Service, Denver Service Center, 1 Denver Federal Center, Building 50, Denver, CO 80225, United States. Contact: Cory Terrell. Phone: 303-969-2540. Email: cory_terrell@ios.doi.gov. Website: https://sam.gov/opp/5b90ec294e3642ec8f64e101690c31fc/view
notes: Special Notice; Project Number 140P2026R0055. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Contract duration 60 months, not renewable. Questions deadline: 2026-05-06 12:00 PM MDT. Although categorized under General Building, the notice is an unspecific regional IDIQ and not tied to a defined single project.
